description: This file contains the implementation of the TinyMCE Popup utility, including functions for initializing popup windows, handling resize events, restoring selections, executing commands, and interfacing with external components within the TinyMCE rich text editor.

classes.name: TinyMCE_Popup
classes.description: A utility class for managing popup window interactions within the TinyMCE editor.

methods.name: findWin(w)
methods.description: Traverses parent and opener windows to find a window that has a defined tinyMCE object.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the popup window, setting up references, styles, and event handlers.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Handles the load event of the popup, applying templates and adjusting layout.

methods.name: executeOnLoad
methods.description: Evaluates scripts to be run on load, with special handling for Opera.

methods.name: resizeToInnerSize
methods.description: Resizes the popup to fit its inner content including iframe adjustments.

methods.name: resizeToContent
methods.description: Resizes the window to fit its document content, with platform-specific adjustments.

methods.name: getWindowArg
methods.description: Retrieves arguments passed to the window.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Restores the selection within the editor if stored.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes a command on the selected TinyMCE instance, restoring selection beforehand.

methods.name: openBrowser
methods.description: Opens a file browser dialog, calls external callback.

methods.name: importClass
methods.description: Imports a class from the opener window into the current window context.
